expectations.evidence: Validator trait with validate(&self, value: &str) -> Option<String>. Multiple built-in rules as separate structs. Same architecture as with-skill.
FieldRules holds Vec<Box<dyn Validator>>, iterates all, collects all errors.
Each rule owns its params. Also includes custom(closure) for one-off inline rules — nice ergonomic touch.
Trait-based, adding new rule is just new struct + impl. No modifications needed.
